title: AdCP Version Envelope
description: Release-precision AdCP protocol version negotiation fields, defined once. Request schemas compose this envelope directly through `allOf`. Strict (`additionalProperties: false`) request schemas also redeclare these two fields in their own `properties` via `$ref`, because draft-07 does not evaluate properties across `allOf`. The Trusted Match match requests are the exception: they inline both fields for their strict privacy boundary. On a request, these fields are part of the request payload: the buyer's version pin. Responses do not compose this envelope directly. `core/protocol-envelope.json` composes it, so on a response `adcp_version` and `adcp_major_version` are envelope fields that the server framework stamps beside `status`, `task_id` and the other protocol-layer fields, not task body data.
